description: Build robots.txt that treats search engines, AI answer bots and AI training crawlers separately; validate llms.txt. Operations: "build" — Build robots.txt: allow or block search engines, AI answer engines/assistants and AI training crawlers (named), with Content-Signal and Sitemap lines.; "validate-llms" — Check an llms.txt file against llmstxt.org: one H1, a > summary, H2 sections of Markdown link lists.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: build: One item per line: sitemap URLs (https://…) and paths every crawler should skip (/admin/). May be empty. validate-llms: The llms.txt file to check.

operation.description: build — Build robots.txt: allow or block search engines, AI answer engines/assistants and AI training crawlers (named), with Content-Signal and Sitemap lines. validate-llms — Check an llms.txt file against llmstxt.org: one H1, a > summary, H2 sections of Markdown link lists.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

aiAnswer.description: AI answer engines and assistants that fetch pages to answer a question. Used by: build.

aiTrain.description: Crawlers that collect text to train AI models. Used by: build.

contentSignal.description: Add contentsignals.org Content-Signal lines matching the choices. Used by: build.

search.description: Search engines and every crawler not named (the * group). Used by: build.

name: robots-txt
title: robots.txt Builder & llms.txt Validator
